g.text: Primary roster, 105 observations. Four local deterministic workflows, implementation 0.1.0.
Yellow rows: three added targets. Repeated query IDs identify shared queries, including pst (NRPSPKS_85) and not (NRPS_66).
* Pestalamide E/F structures remain putative; each associated measured feature is the evaluated target.
Intervals are best–worst positions within exact score ties, not biological uncertainty. Nine targets share five queries and one analysis group.
